fusions.name: Scrape Together
fusions.desc: A dragging strike that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 8 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Gather the Fleeing
fusions.desc: Sweeps in a circle, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Gleaned Breath
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 7 seconds.

fusions.name: Leavings Tidied
fusions.desc: When you strike, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
